title: Zhang--Feng--Khandelwal finite-strain periodic composite, Table 5
purpose: Provide a fail-closed numerical comparison and evidence-audit fixture for regional finite-strain J2 periodic-cell analysis without embedding external answers in solver logic. Candidate schema v2 binds the checkout runtime, benchmark driver, geometry fixture, discretization axes, outputs and stage-level performance; the audit still cannot promote this external benchmark until every independent convergence and reproducibility gate passes.
physics: Plane-strain periodic composite with two stiff circular inclusions, one circular void, logarithmic finite-strain J2 matrix plasticity, elastic inclusions, and macroscopic simple shear.

source.authors: G. Zhang, N. Feng and K. Khandelwal
source.title: A computational framework for homogenization and multiscale stability analyses of nonlinear periodic materials
source.journal: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering 122 (2021), 6527--6575
source.reference: Section 3.2.1, Figure 10(a), Table 5 and Appendix B in the inspected author manuscript
source.geometry_provenance: The inspected author manuscript prose and Figure 10(a) disagree on phase placement. Existing default section-3.2.1-text puts the void at (0.2, 0); explicit figure-10a puts the void at (-0.2, -0.2). See evidence/zhang_2021/geometry-source-discrepancy.md. The final publisher PDF has not been checked for this discrepancy.
source.mixed_formulation_reference: T. Sussman and K.-J. Bathe, Computers & Structures 26 (1987) 357--409, https://doi.org/10.1016/0045-7949(87)90265-3

parameters.unit_cell: unit square, plane strain, unit reference thickness
parameters.pressure_interpolation: three element-local discontinuous modes spanning 1, r and s on the reference quadrilateral

execution.evidence: The fixture creates the published geometry with Gmsh physical regions, exact opposite-face periodic node pairing, the public affine-periodic constraint, regional finite-strain J2 materials, model.step, accepted quadrature state, and periodic-cell history. The primary diagnostic uses the two-dimensional Q9/DPC1 plane-strain route, reports an explicitly reconstructed primal Hencky elastic energy beside the condensed mixed channel and its gap decomposition, and condenses the converged full Jacobian through an exact macro-gradient lift to obtain the current-state algorithmic tangent without rerunning the load path. A homogeneous Q9/DPC1 elastic check verifies the tangent convention, and an independent Appendix-B inverse-plastic-metric oracle verifies the material-point stress, state and energy update on a non-coaxial path. Candidate schema v2 hashes the scientific runtime, fixture and driver at both start and end, rejects cross-worktree imports and source mutation during a run, distinguishes unavailable stage timings from measured zero, and binds the actually executed high-order mesh, cell and boundary tags, and periodic equation graph. Load-path and quadrature audits require that complete discretization identity to remain unchanged. Unarchived Q9/DPC1 diagnostics using 315, 459, 804, 1590 and 2859 elements reduced the primal-energy error from 20.539 to 4.205 percent while the first-Piola vector error remained between 4.845 and 5.592 percent; the 2859-element run is close to the paper's reported 2823-element count but does not reproduce its unpublished topology or curved-boundary approximation. A separate 315-element study showed load-path convergence from 20 to 40 to 80 increments and quadrature convergence from order 4 to 6 to 8, so neither increment count nor quadrature order explains the remaining Table 5 discrepancy. On the same coarse route, a clean-source, content-bound 1e-5/1e-6/1e-7 centered final-macro-gradient study with the entire earlier path and pre-increment committed state fixed passes the independent audit: the coarse-to-middle observed order is 1.998, the two finest finite-difference tangents differ by 1.36e-8, and the middle point agrees with the condensed tangent to 1.43e-8 relative Frobenius error. That tangent still differs from Table 5 by about 21.68 percent. This PETSc-style check rejects an internally inconsistent Jacobian explanation but does not promote the external benchmark. The older thin-3D tetrahedral P2/DG0 route remains a distinct diagnostic. No promoted evidence set yet satisfies every Table 5, spatial/formulation, cell-replication, MPI and restart gate; the benchmark therefore remains unpromoted.

observables: Homogenized first-Piola stress in the published column-major order.

Primal Hencky elastic energy per complete reference-cell measure, reconstructed from aligned accepted F, mean-Kirchhoff-stress, inverse-bulk-modulus, and condensed ELENER fields; HARDENER, cumulative PDENER, and the mixed saddle potential are excluded.
Condensed mixed elastic energy, signed primal-minus-condensed gap, signed pressure-orthogonality contribution, nonnegative pressure-constraint-defect contribution, and decomposition residual.
Exact DG0 or DPC mean-Kirchhoff-stress primary field in SimulationResult and portable checkpoint; DPC XDMF uses the separately named *_CELL recovery.
The maximum quadrature defect max_q |ln(J_q)-p_h(q)/kappa|, which is not a DG0 quantity for DPC1 and is not the assembled pressure-block residual.
Homogenized algorithmic tangent in the published component order.
Periodic equation mismatch and opposite-face pairing error.
Mesh, plane-strain formulation, cell-size, serial/MPI, and restart convergence evidence.
acceptance: First-Piola stress, primal Hencky elastic energy, and effective tangent must each satisfy the declared 3 percent comparison contract inside a candidate whose runtime, fixture, driver, inputs and outputs are content-bound; passing those scalar comparisons alone is not benchmark promotion.
The result must be converged with respect to load-increment/path, mesh, and the numerical plane-strain representation; a thin-extrusion route must include thickness convergence.
First-Piola stress must satisfy both vector-norm and componentwise absolute-plus-relative contracts so a small published component cannot be hidden by the global norm.
The 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2 cells must preserve the published cell-size invariance.
Serial and MPI execution and checkpoint/restart must preserve the accepted response.
Missing caller assertions produce incomplete; any supplied observable outside tolerance produces failed.

The promotion audit must independently verify content identity, controlled convergence axes, clean-source execution and stable start/end identities; any unbound, mixed-definition or source-mutated candidate is rejected rather than downgraded to an accepted comparison.
limitations: Historical diagnostics below use prose geometry. With explicit figure-10a geometry, a dirty-checkout 2859-cell/40-increment diagnostic gives 0.099 percent stress, 0.014 percent primal-energy and 0.507 percent tangent errors. All numerical comparisons pass, but the final mesh pair changes energy by 5.3442 percent, so mesh convergence and full benchmark promotion remain unestablished. Prior prose-geometry lifecycle evidence cannot automatically promote this alternative.

The publication uses a two-dimensional quadrilateral Q2 nine-node displacement field with a DPC1 three-mode discontinuous pressure space. AgentFEM now executes that interpolation on the exact complex geometry as a diagnostic, but it has no locking-, path-, formulation-, or mesh-convergence claim and is not promoted benchmark evidence.

The published elastic inclusions are represented in the shared regional transaction by the same J2 provider with an intentionally unreachable yield stress; they remain elastic over the declared path but are not a distinct elastic constitutive implementation.

The unarchived thin-3D diagnostic passed the first-Piola vector-L2 threshold but failed the P11 and P22 componentwise checks. Its condensed ELENER is not comparable with the Table 5 primal Hencky energy; that physical-energy gate remained incomplete. Its reported periodic and Hill--Mandel values do not replace a sealed evidence archive, so the benchmark is not promoted.

For the mixed provider, K/mu <= 1e4 is a temporary implementation ceiling for subtractive tangent construction. A plastic simple-shear direction test guards tangent accuracy at the ceiling, but the value is not a general accuracy range, a constitutive validity range, or proof against volumetric locking. Residual, max_q |ln(J_q)-p_h(q)/kappa|, energy, and mesh/formulation convergence remain separate requirements.

Exact DPC primary values remain in SimulationResult and portable checkpoints. XDMF intentionally writes an explicitly recovered DG0 *_CELL field rather than relabeling multiple DPC moments as one exact cell value.

For the mixed route, ELENER is an integrated condensed elastic-energy diagnostic per reference-cell measure; it is not the Table 5 primal-energy comparison channel. The explicit energy diagnostic reconstructs the primal channel and retains the signed gap, pressure-orthogonality, nonnegative constraint-defect, and decomposition-residual terms. HARDENER is separate recoverable hardening storage, PDENER is cumulative irrecoverable energy per reference volume, and MIXED_POTENTIAL is not physical stored energy.

The publication reports the element family and count but not the mesh connectivity, curved-boundary approximation, exact increment schedule, constitutive integration implementation or executable in-house Matlab CPSSL-FEA source. Table 5 is therefore a discrete external reproduction target, not an analytic oracle; unexplained disagreement cannot be tuned away or attributed to AgentFEM without controlled formulation, topology and algorithm studies.

The exact complex Q9/DPC1 execution remains diagnostic. Its driver recovers a current-state homogenized algorithmic tangent with the pre-increment committed state fixed and the local return mapping consistently linearized. A clean-source, content-bound three-level centered-difference study independently confirms that discrete tangent, but Table 5 agreement, full spatial/formulation convergence, 1x1/1x2/2x1/2x2 replication invariance, distributed mixed execution, portable restart, and a promoted evidence archive remain required before this external gate can pass.
